entries.meaningZh: 老于世故的；善于处世的
entries.en: A worldly-wise friend warned me not to sign the blank contract.
entries.zh: 一位老于世故的朋友提醒我不要在空白合同上签字。

entries.en: The worn soles let water into his boots whenever it rained.
entries.zh: 每逢下雨，他靴子磨损的鞋底就会进水。

entries.en: She looked worried when the last bus left without her younger brother.
entries.zh: 末班车开走时，她弟弟还没上车，她显得很担心。

entries.en: The librarian found the old atlas through the library's card catalog.
entries.zh: 图书管理员通过馆内的卡片目录找到了那本旧地图集。

entries.en: They will brick in the unused doorway before winter.
entries.zh: 他们将在入冬前用砖封住那个不用的门口。

entries.en: Sound reflection from the stone walls made the empty hall echo.
entries.zh: 声音在石墙上的反射让空荡的大厅产生了回声。

entries.en: The repairer replaced a cracked electron tube inside the old radio.
entries.zh: 维修人员换掉了旧收音机里一只开裂的电子管。

entries.en: The patient's record included the size and location of a kidney stone.
entries.zh: 病历记录了一颗肾结石的大小和位置。

entries.meaningZh: 面对池面起跳的反身翻腾跳水
entries.en: He practised a full gainer from the diving board under close supervision.
entries.zh: 他在密切监督下练习从跳板起跳的反身翻腾跳水。

entries.en: A worrying crack appeared above the kitchen window after the storm.
entries.zh: 暴风雨过后，厨房窗户上方出现了一道令人担忧的裂缝。

entries.en: The second storm caused worse damage than the first.
entries.zh: 第二场暴风雨造成的损害比第一场更严重。

entries.en: The tailor cut a length of dark worsted for the suit.
entries.zh: 裁缝为那套西装裁了一段深色精纺毛料。

entries.en: The new key would not turn in the door's cylinder lock.
entries.zh: 新钥匙无法在门上的圆筒弹子锁里转动。

entries.en: The waiter examined the bottle cork before pouring the wine.
entries.zh: 侍者倒酒前检查了瓶塞。

entries.en: The lecture traced the history of the American electoral college.
entries.zh: 这堂课梳理了美国总统选举人团的历史。

entries.en: The archived report listed valvular heart disease among the diagnoses.
entries.zh: 这份存档报告把心脏瓣膜病列在诊断结果之中。

entries.en: Stir the thick batter gently with a wooden spoon.
entries.zh: 用木匙轻轻搅拌浓稠的面糊。

entries.en: She set a bottle of steak sauce beside the grilled beef.
entries.zh: 她在烤牛肉旁放了一瓶佐肉调味辣酱。

entries.en: The laboratory manual specified a biosafety level for each testing room.
entries.zh: 实验室手册规定了各个检测室的生物安全等级。

entries.en: A clean bandage covered the wound on his forearm.
entries.zh: 他前臂的伤口上盖着一块干净的绷带。

entries.en: The volunteers carried a wounded sailor onto the rescue boat.
entries.zh: 志愿者把一名受伤的水手抬上了救援船。

entries.en: We changed the spatial arrangement of the desks to create wider aisles.
entries.zh: 我们调整了书桌的空间布局，让过道更宽敞。

entries.en: Use the blunt tool to tease apart the tangled wool.
entries.zh: 用那件钝头工具把缠结的羊毛纤维梳开。

entries.en: We decided to order a la carte instead of taking the set menu.
entries.zh: 我们决定按菜单单点，而不选套餐。

entries.en: In the exercise, multiplying by the identity matrix left the matrix unchanged.
entries.zh: 在这道练习中，乘以单位矩阵后，原矩阵保持不变。

entries.en: A brief electric discharge lit the gas inside the sealed tube.
entries.zh: 一次短暂的放电使密封管内的气体发光。

entries.en: She secured the loose cardboard lid with a strip of duct tape.
entries.zh: 她用一条管道胶带固定住松动的纸板盖。

entries.en: The school held a rummage sale to raise money for new library books.
entries.zh: 学校举行了一场捐赠物品义卖，为购买新的图书馆藏书筹款。

entries.en: Keep the paper wrapping until you have checked the fragile gift.
entries.zh: 在检查过这件易碎的礼物之前，先保留纸质包装材料。

entries.en: Our school added wrestling to its winter sports programme.
entries.zh: 我们学校把摔跤加入了冬季体育活动项目。

entries.en: His wrinkled shirt looked untidy after a night in the suitcase.
entries.zh: 他的衬衫在行李箱里放了一夜，皱巴巴的，显得不整洁。

entries.en: The photographer checked the flash lamp before taking the indoor portraits.
entries.zh: 摄影师在拍摄室内人像前检查了闪光灯。

entries.en: The technician inspected the fuel pod beneath the aircraft's wing.
entries.zh: 技术员检查了飞机机翼下方的副油箱。

entries.en: We played miniature golf on a course with tiny bridges and tunnels.
entries.zh: 我们在有小桥和小隧道的球场上玩了迷你高尔夫球。

entries.en: He poured chilled carrot juice into two small glasses.
entries.zh: 他把冰镇胡萝卜汁倒进两个小玻璃杯里。

entries.en: A chatter mark on the metal surface revealed vibration during machining.
entries.zh: 金属表面的一道振纹显示加工时存在振动。

entries.meaningZh: 填写名单外候选人姓名的选票
entries.en: Her write-in was rejected because the name was illegible.
entries.zh: 她那张填写名单外候选人姓名的选票因名字无法辨认而被拒收。

entries.en: Her writing became clearer after she shortened the longest sentences.
entries.zh: 她把最长的几个句子缩短后，文章变得更清晰了。

entries.en: Please send written instructions so the next shift can follow the same procedure.
entries.zh: 请发送书面说明，让下个班次也能按同样的程序操作。

entries.en: After the match, the athlete asked the therapist to rub down his tired shoulders.
entries.zh: 比赛后，那名运动员请理疗师给他疲惫的肩膀做按摩。

entries.en: The diagram used circles to represent each electron shell around the nucleus.
entries.zh: 这幅图用圆圈表示原子核周围的各个电子壳层。

entries.en: She joined a driving school after moving to a town with limited buses.
entries.zh: 她搬到公交不多的小镇后，报名参加了驾校培训。

entries.en: The museum displayed chain armour made from hundreds of linked metal rings.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了由数百个相扣金属环制成的锁子甲。

entries.en: The running back carried the ball past two defenders.
entries.zh: 那名跑卫带球越过了两名防守队员。

entries.en: The archive catalogued the magazine as a serial publication.
entries.zh: 档案馆把这本杂志编目为连续出版物。

entries.en: The microscope image showed a goblet cell beside other cells in the lining.
entries.zh: 显微镜图像显示，内衬组织中有一个杯状细胞，旁边还有其他细胞。

entries.en: The display included wrought silver shaped into flowers and birds.
entries.zh: 展品中有加工成花鸟形状的银器。

entries.en: The yachtswoman checked the rigging before sailing out of the harbour.
entries.zh: 那位女帆船运动员出港前检查了帆索装置。

entries.en: Letters from home stirred a deep yearning for the village she had left.
entries.zh: 家乡的来信勾起了她对离开的那个村庄的深切思念。

entries.en: The lecturer traced a geodesic line across the model's curved surface.
entries.zh: 讲师沿模型的弯曲表面描出了一条测地线。

entries.en: The mining exhibit included a model of a stamp battery used to crush ore.
entries.zh: 矿业展览展出了一座用于捣碎矿石的连续捣矿杵组模型。

entries.en: The fossils helped the team assign the rock layer to a geological period.
entries.zh: 这些化石帮助研究小组确定该岩层所属的地质时期。

entries.en: Volunteers planting trees along the river showed a strong sense of civic pride.
entries.zh: 沿河植树的志愿者展现了强烈的城市自豪感。

entries.en: The patient's notes described the timing of each labor pain.
entries.zh: 患者的记录描述了每次分娩阵痛出现的时间。

entries.en: The director wanted honest advice, not another yes-man at the meeting.
entries.zh: 董事想在会上听到坦诚的建议，而不是再来一个唯命是从的人。

entries.meaningZh: 易弯曲的；易受压变形的
entries.en: The yielding branches bent under the weight of the wet snow.
entries.zh: 柔韧的树枝在湿雪的重压下弯了下来。

entries.en: A short walk gave him the zing he needed for the afternoon.
entries.zh: 散了一小会儿步，让他有了应付下午所需的活力。

entries.en: A flood lamp lit the entire wall for the photographer.
entries.zh: 一盏泛光灯为摄影师照亮了整面墙。

entries.en: The developer copied the binary program into the computer's application folder.
entries.zh: 开发人员把二进制程序复制到计算机的应用程序文件夹中。

entries.en: The textbook included a short explanation of the pocket veto.
entries.zh: 教材简要解释了搁置否决这一概念。

entries.en: The historian marked the communication trench on a map of the old battlefield.
entries.zh: 历史学家在旧战场地图上标出了交通壕。

entries.en: We checked the inverse function by composing it with the original function.
entries.zh: 我们把反函数与原函数复合，以检验它。

entries.en: The bartender dried each beer mug before putting it on the shelf.
entries.zh: 酒保把每只带柄啤酒杯擦干后，放到了架子上。

entries.en: The museum kept the antique arms behind a locked glass panel.
entries.zh: 博物馆把那些古董武器存放在上锁的玻璃隔板后面。

entries.en: A bent nail lay beside the carpenter's hammer.
entries.zh: 木匠的锤子旁边放着一根弯钉子。

entries.en: The wider desk was a better choice for the shared office.
entries.zh: 那张较宽的书桌更适合这间共用办公室。

entries.en: The sailor pointed to a tide rip where the two currents met.
entries.zh: 水手指向两股水流相遇处形成的一片湍浪。

entries.en: The snapshot program printed register values when execution reached the chosen instruction.
entries.zh: 抽点打印程序在执行到选定指令时打印了寄存器的值。

entries.meaningZh: 二级存储器；辅助存储器
entries.en: The diagram placed the hard drive under the heading of secondary storage.
entries.zh: 这幅图把硬盘列在二级存储器一栏。

entries.en: Our field hockey team practises on the grass behind the school.
entries.zh: 我们的草地曲棍球队在学校后面的草地上训练。

entries.en: An exhibit explained how the killer bee differs from other honeybees.
entries.zh: 一个展览介绍了杀人蜂与其他蜜蜂有何区别。

entries.en: The historical photograph showed a reconnaissance plane above the coastline.
entries.zh: 这张历史照片显示，一架侦察机飞在海岸线上空。

entries.en: Long metal straps formed the joint hinge on the old wooden gate.
entries.zh: 旧木门上的接合铰链由长金属片构成。

entries.en: The carpenter found a bit of glass beneath the broken window.
entries.zh: 木匠在破窗下找到了一小块玻璃。

entries.en: These boxes are bound for a village beyond the hills.
entries.zh: 这些箱子准备运往山那边的一个村庄。

entries.en: The expected delivery date passed, but the parcel had not arrived.
entries.zh: 预计送达日期已过，包裹却还没到。

entries.en: The technician removed dust from the fan above the central processing unit.
entries.zh: 技术员清除了中央处理器上方风扇上的灰尘。

entries.en: One cowboy boot had elaborate stitching along its side.
entries.zh: 其中一只牛仔靴的侧面有精细的缝线花纹。

entries.en: He opened a tin can of beans for supper.
entries.zh: 他打开了一罐豆子罐头当晚餐。

entries.en: The curator labelled the blank shell before placing it in the display case.
entries.zh: 馆员给那枚空包弹贴上标签后，才把它放进展柜。

entries.en: The old judgment identified the plaintiff in error on its first page.
entries.zh: 那份旧判决在第一页列明了提请复审的当事人。

entries.en: The course compared complex instruction set computing with simpler instruction architectures.
entries.zh: 这门课把复杂指令集计算技术与指令较简单的架构作了比较。

entries.en: We walked farther along the canal before finding a quiet place to rest.
entries.zh: 我们沿运河又往前走了一段，才找到安静的休息处。

entries.en: The letter left her with a warm feeling of gratitude.
entries.zh: 那封信让她心生温暖的感激之情。

entries.en: A folding chair stood behind the counter for the tired cashier.
entries.zh: 柜台后放着一把折叠椅，供疲惫的收银员使用。

entries.en: The lecturer placed the zero coupon bond's only payment at the end of the timeline.
entries.zh: 讲师把那只无息票债券的唯一一笔付款标在时间线的末端。

entries.en: The bakery's sour bread had a chewy crust and a pleasantly tangy flavour.
entries.zh: 那家面包店的酸面包外皮有嚼劲，酸味宜人。

entries.en: The fishmonger arranged ocean perch on a bed of crushed ice.
entries.zh: 鱼贩把海鲈摆在一层碎冰上。

entries.en: Local cafés tried to make hay while the festival brought extra visitors.
entries.zh: 节庆带来更多游客，当地咖啡馆想趁机多做些生意。

entries.en: At flying school, she practised landing with an instructor beside her.
entries.zh: 在飞行学校，她在教练陪同下练习着陆。

entries.en: The empty ammunition chest became part of the museum's battlefield display.
entries.zh: 那只空弹药箱成了博物馆战场主题展览的一部分。

entries.en: The exchange programme helped further cooperation between the two universities.
entries.zh: 这个交流项目有助于促进两所大学之间的合作。

entries.en: I left my glasses beside the book I was reading.
entries.zh: 我把眼镜放在了正在读的那本书旁边。

entries.en: She sold the little bakery as a going concern rather than closing it.
entries.zh: 她把那家小面包店作为一家仍在经营的企业出售，而不是将其关闭。

entries.en: The mechanics hoped to soup up the racing aircraft's engine before the trial.
entries.zh: 机械师希望在试飞前提高那架竞速飞机发动机的功率。

entries.en: Old rivals showed brotherly love by helping each other rebuild their homes.
entries.zh: 昔日的对手彼此帮忙重建家园，表现出了兄弟般的情谊。

entries.en: The parquet floor creaked as the dancers crossed the room.
entries.zh: 舞者们穿过房间时，镶花地板发出吱嘎声。

entries.en: The laboratory used quantitative analysis to measure the amount of copper in the sample.
entries.zh: 实验室用定量分析测定样品中铜的含量。

entries.en: The internal auditor reviewed travel receipts before reporting to the board.
entries.zh: 内部审计员在向董事会汇报前审核了差旅收据。

entries.en: The case notes documented an episode of insulin shock.
entries.zh: 病例记录了一次胰岛素休克发作。

entries.en: The wet ground made the shortcut across the field difficult.
entries.zh: 潮湿的地面让穿过田野的那条捷径不好走。

entries.en: I will return the borrowed dictionary later this afternoon.
entries.zh: 我今天下午晚些时候会归还借来的词典。

entries.meaningZh: 因同一罪名受到两次审理
entries.en: The seminar compared different arguments about double jeopardy.
entries.zh: 研讨会比较了关于同一罪名受到两次审理的不同论点。

entries.en: The historian compared the pragmatic sanction with earlier imperial decrees.
entries.zh: 历史学家把那份国事诏书与更早的帝国诏令作了比较。

entries.en: The archive classified the operation as a total hysterectomy.
entries.zh: 档案把这次手术归类为子宫全切术。

entries.en: A splash of grape juice left a purple mark on the cloth.
entries.zh: 溅出的葡萄汁在布上留下了一块紫色印迹。

entries.en: The model rocket demonstrated reaction propulsion by ejecting gas through its nozzle.
entries.zh: 这个火箭模型通过喷嘴喷出气体，演示了反作用力推进。

entries.en: The archivist labelled each tape cartridge before placing it on the storage shelf.
entries.zh: 档案员给每盒磁带贴上标签后，将其放到储物架上。

entries.en: Please lay the fragile tiles flat on the padded table.
entries.zh: 请把易碎的瓷砖平放在铺有软垫的桌子上。

entries.en: The lost parcel turned up behind a pile of boxes.
entries.zh: 丢失的包裹在一堆箱子后面找到了。

entries.en: The number on her ticket matched the label above the empty seat.
entries.zh: 她票上的号码与空座位上方的标识相符。

entries.en: The neighbours met to patch up their differences over the shared driveway.
entries.zh: 邻居们见面商谈，想解决关于共用车道的分歧。

entries.en: The shop's accounting system recorded each payment in date order.
entries.zh: 这家店的会计系统按日期顺序记录每笔付款。

entries.en: A bell jar protected the delicate model from dust.
entries.zh: 一个钟形玻璃罩保护着那件精巧的模型，免受灰尘影响。

entries.en: The scrub nurse prepared the sterile instruments before the surgeon entered.
entries.zh: 洗手护士在外科医生进来前准备好了无菌器械。

entries.en: Their mutual affection survived years of living in different countries.
entries.zh: 虽然多年住在不同国家，他们彼此间的情分依然存在。

entries.en: Her drawing received an honorable mention at the school art show.
entries.zh: 她的画在学校艺术展上获得了荣誉奖。

entries.en: He used his deep bass voice to sing the lowest line in the chorus.
entries.zh: 他用浑厚的男低音演唱合唱中的最低声部。

entries.en: She was pleased with the neat rows of seedlings in the garden.
entries.zh: 她对花园里那一排排整齐的幼苗很满意。

entries.meaningZh: 房屋及其场地；经营场所
entries.en: The bakery moved to larger premises near the station.
entries.zh: 那家面包店搬到了车站附近更大的经营场所。

entries.en: Archaeologists uncovered the remains of a stone wall beneath the path.
entries.zh: 考古学家在小路下发现了一堵石墙的残迹。

entries.meaningZh: 保险杠护杆；缓冲保护器
entries.en: The mechanic straightened the damaged bumper guard on the old truck.
entries.zh: 机械师把旧卡车上受损的保险杠护杆扳直了。

entries.en: The catcher waited behind home plate for the next pitch.
entries.zh: 捕手在本垒板后等待下一次投球。

entries.en: Her score reached double digits for the first time that season.
entries.zh: 她的得分在那个赛季首次达到了两位数。

entries.en: The lamp's cable was too short to reach the electric outlet.
entries.zh: 台灯的电线太短，够不到电源插座。

entries.en: We heard the musicians tuning their instruments in the orchestra pit.
entries.zh: 我们听见乐手们在乐池里给乐器调音。

entries.en: The dog was sound asleep beside the warm stove.
entries.zh: 那条狗在温暖的炉子旁睡得很熟。

entries.en: The spectators enjoyed the running at the school sports day.
entries.zh: 观众喜欢学校运动会上的赛跑项目。

entries.en: She used part of her savings to repair the leaking roof.
entries.zh: 她用部分存款修好了漏水的屋顶。

entries.en: His final shot bounced off the rim before dropping into the basket.
entries.zh: 他最后那次投篮先弹在篮圈上，随后落进了篮筐。

entries.en: He used a hand mower to cut the small patch of lawn.
entries.zh: 他用手推割草机修剪了那一小片草坪。

entries.en: A grandfather clause allowed existing members to keep their old fees.
entries.zh: 一项保留条款允许现有会员继续按原来的标准缴费。

entries.en: The diagram used arrows to show the path of a nervous impulse.
entries.zh: 示意图用箭头标出了神经冲动传导的路径。

entries.en: The carpenter's square helped her check the corners of the wooden frame.
entries.zh: 木工矩尺帮助她检查了木框的各个角。

entries.en: The bride hung her wedding gown away from the open window.
entries.zh: 新娘把婚纱挂在了远离敞开窗户的地方。

entries.en: The surrounding hills sheltered the village from the strongest winds.
entries.zh: 周围的山丘为村庄挡住了最强的风。

entries.en: The ceremony included the swearing of an oath to tell the truth before witnesses.
entries.zh: 仪式包括在见证人面前宣誓说实话。

entries.en: She sent a handwritten note to express her thanks for the help.
entries.zh: 她寄出一张手写便条，对得到的帮助表达谢意。

entries.en: The academy teaches classical ballet alongside modern dance.
entries.zh: 这所学院既教古典芭蕾舞，也教现代舞。

entries.en: One rear lamp on the old car glowed more dimly than the other.
entries.zh: 那辆旧车的一盏尾灯比另一盏暗。

entries.en: She mistook the mathematical symbol for a letter in the handwritten notes.
entries.zh: 她把手写笔记中的那个数学符号误看成了一个字母。

entries.en: The library grouped novels by literary genre rather than by publication date.
entries.zh: 图书馆按文学体裁而非出版日期给小说分类。

entries.en: The laboratory demonstration produced a stationary wave along the stretched string.
entries.zh: 实验室演示在绷紧的弦上产生了驻波。

entries.en: Lay the clean cloth over the tray before the guests arrive.
entries.zh: 在客人到来前，把干净的布盖在托盘上。

entries.en: A small propeller plane carried supplies to the island.
entries.zh: 一架小型螺旋桨飞机向岛上运送了补给。

entries.en: We found a working radio among the discarded electrical goods.
entries.zh: 我们在废弃电器中找到了一台还能用的收音机。

entries.en: A restored traction engine pulled the decorated wagon through the village.
entries.zh: 一台修复的蒸汽牵引机拉着装饰过的货车穿过村庄。

entries.en: The diagram showed secondary emission from the surface struck by incoming electrons.
entries.zh: 示意图显示了被入射电子轰击的表面产生二次发射。

entries.en: The saddle roof had a triangular gable at each end.
entries.zh: 这座鞍状屋顶的两端各有一面三角形山墙。

entries.en: The children clapped two steady beats per bar to practise duple time.
entries.zh: 孩子们每小节稳定地拍两下，练习二拍子。

entries.en: The stopwatch displayed the elapsed time beside the runner's name.
entries.zh: 秒表在跑步者姓名旁显示了已经过的时间。

entries.en: We wrote the starting time beside each event on the noticeboard.
entries.zh: 我们在布告栏上给每项活动写上了开始时间。

entries.en: The exhibit showed how time sharing let several terminals use one central computer.
entries.zh: 展览介绍了分时技术如何让多台终端使用一台中央计算机。

entries.en: The curve approached its horizontal asymptote without crossing it in the plotted interval.
entries.zh: 在绘出的区间内，这条曲线趋近于水平渐近线而没有穿过它。

entries.en: The observatory stored decades of atmospherical measurements in labelled folders.
entries.zh: 观测站把数十年的大气测量记录保存在贴有标签的文件夹中。

entries.meaningZh: 视觉笑料；无言的滑稽表演
entries.en: A sight gag involving an oversized suitcase made the audience laugh.
entries.zh: 一段围绕超大号行李箱展开的视觉笑料逗笑了观众。

entries.en: The log recorded both events in coordinated universal time to avoid confusion.
entries.zh: 日志用协调世界时记录了两次事件，以免混淆。

entries.en: She added a grave accent above the vowel in the French word.
entries.zh: 她在那个法语单词的元音字母上方加了一个抑音符。

entries.en: The lecture examined how the banking system changed during the crisis.
entries.zh: 这堂课分析了银行体系在危机期间如何变化。

entries.en: The sleep chart marked a period of nonrapid eye movement before the next stage.
entries.zh: 睡眠图标出了进入下一阶段前的一段非快速眼动睡眠。

entries.en: The archived file contained the findings of a bank examination.
entries.zh: 存档文件中载有一次银行检查的调查结果。

entries.en: A glass atomiser stood beside the perfume bottles on the dresser.
entries.zh: 梳妆台上，香水瓶旁放着一个玻璃喷雾器。

entries.en: The experiment compared the audibleness of quiet tones against different background noises.
entries.zh: 实验比较了不同背景噪声下微弱音调的可听度。

entries.en: In the written addition exercise, she underlined the augend before adding the second number.
entries.zh: 在那道笔算加法练习中，她先在被加数下面画线，再加上第二个数。

entries.en: The empty round-bottom flask rested in a padded wooden rack.
entries.zh: 空圆底烧瓶放在一个带衬垫的木架上。

entries.en: She practised the plain stitch on a small square of blue wool.
entries.zh: 她用蓝色毛线在一小块方形织片上练习平针。

entries.en: The poet paired 'glowing' with 'flowing' to create a double rhyme.
entries.zh: 诗人把 glowing 与 flowing 搭配，形成了一个双音节韵。

entries.en: The exercise asked us to sketch an exponential function on the grid.
entries.zh: 这道练习要求我们在方格纸上画出一个指数函数。

entries.en: In the novel, her mortal enemy repeatedly threatens to kill her.
entries.zh: 小说中，她的死敌反复威胁要杀死她。

entries.en: Rain drummed on the slate roof throughout the night.
entries.zh: 雨点整夜敲打着板岩屋顶。

entries.en: The flooded paddy field reflected the evening sky.
entries.zh: 灌满水的稻田映出了傍晚的天空。

entries.en: The geologist kept the auriferous rock in a labelled specimen box.
entries.zh: 地质学家把那块含金岩石保存在贴有标签的标本盒里。

entries.en: The programmer used a list-processing language to rearrange symbolic expressions.
entries.zh: 程序员用一种表处理语言重新排列符号表达式。

entries.en: A bottle of hand lotion stood beside the washbasin.
entries.zh: 洗手盆旁放着一瓶润手乳液。

entries.en: The historian's report distinguished registration fire from the later bombardment.
entries.zh: 历史学家的报告区分了试射与后来的轰击。

entries.en: The supervisory program paused one task while another used the processor.
entries.zh: 监控程序暂停了一个任务，同时让另一个任务使用处理器。

entries.en: The anatomy diagram labelled the blind gut near the beginning of the large intestine.
entries.zh: 解剖图在大肠起始处附近标出了盲肠。

entries.en: Excitement reached fever pitch as the final whistle approached.
entries.zh: 终场哨声即将响起时，兴奋情绪达到了狂热的程度。

entries.en: The old correspondence described the quartermaster general checking army supply records.
entries.zh: 旧信函描述了军需总监检查军队补给记录的情况。
